# DeepL API plans

 Content is translated from English using DeepL Pro. 

DeepL's API is accessible through all of [the DeepL API](https://www.deepl.com/pro#developer) plans. API plans were specifically created for developers and for anyone who wants to integrate [DeepL’s REST API](https://developers.deepl.com/) into their own products and platforms.

Our [API documentation](https://developers.deepl.com/) applies for all API plans.

None of these plans give you access to Pro services in the web translator and desktop apps.

Developer API Growth API Enterprise API API Free API Pro

DeepL API Developer allows developers to translate **up to 1,000,000 characters in total**. Once this limit is reached, **it is not reset** and you will need to upgrade to DeepL API Growth.

The DeepL API Developer plan does not include access to speech to text translation. If you want to translate more characters or use the speech to text translation feature, you can upgrade to [DeepL API Growth](https://www.deepl.com/pro#developer) at any time.

A subscription to DeepL API Growth offers:

*   Maximum data security (your texts are deleted immediately after the translation or improvement)
*   DeepL translation quality
*   Access to the DeepL API for Write
*   Speech to text translation
*   Fixed monthly or yearly price with included characters and speech to text translation hours (consumption above the included characters is invoiced based on usage)
*   Set a monthly maximum cost control limit
*   Set API key-based usage limits
*   API key can be used in CAT tool plug-ins
*   Access to the next-generation language model and additional languages
*   Configure several admins for API key management
*   Monthly usage limits: 50 million characters and 300 speech to text hours

Enterprise API allows business customers to set up **large-scale, long-term API projects** by purchasing custom character and speech to text commitments.

Reach out to our[Sales Team](https://www.deepl.com/contact-us)to learn more about Enterprise API.

**The DeepL API Free plan can no longer be purchased.**

A subscription to DeepL API Free does not include access to DeepL Write or speech to text translation. DeepL API Free allows developers to translate up to 500,000 characters per month for free. If you want to translate more characters or use the speech to text translation feature, you can upgrade to [DeepL API Growth](https://www.deepl.com/pro#developer) at any time.

**The DeepL API Pro plan can no longer be purchased**.

A subscription to DeepL API Pro offers:

*   Maximum data security (your texts are deleted immediately after the translation or improvement)
*   DeepL translation quality
*   A billing model based on a monthly fixed price per month + usage-based costs per translated character
*   Set a monthly maximum cost control limit
*   Set API key-based usage limits
*   No volume restriction on the number of characters you can translate or rephrase per month (usage-based pay-as-you-go prices apply)
*   API key can be used in CAT tool plug-ins
*   Access to the DeepL API for Write
*   Speech to text translation
*   Access to the next-generation language model and additional languages
*   Configure several admins for API key management
